name: copywriting-kit
description: Rewrite your website and marketing copy so it is clearer, using only your product facts. Diagnose what is wrong with your homepage messaging and how your site explains what you sell before any rewrite, draft landing, product and pricing pages from your brief, check marketing claims against evidence you provide, and capture your brand voice from your own writing. Edits keep every number, name and claim; proof, testimonials and urgency are never invented.

interface.longDescription: Five skills for your own web pages and drafts. Edit a draft and get the clean text first, with a short list of changes and every number, name and claim kept. Diagnose existing copy: what is broken first (positioning, message order or wording), the top changes, and a checklist score, before any rewrite. Check claims against the evidence you provide and get accurate rewrites. Draft a landing, product, pricing or about page from your facts, with gaps listed instead of invented proof. Capture a voice profile from your own writing samples. Proof, urgency and testimonials are never invented. Not for ads, outreach or errors-only proofreading.
defaultPrompt: Edit this, keep every number: 'Northwind Ledger is a revolutionary platform that empowers teams to cut invoice time by 40%.'
Check against my notes: 'The leading invoicing tool, trusted by 10,000 teams.' Notes: 212 paying customers, no ranking data.
Diagnose before any rewrite: 'Reimagine finance. All-in-one for every business. Offer ends tonight! Get started | Book a demo'
